title: "rungar scale-sets rm"
description: "Remove a scale set that is no longer configured: its runners, then the scale set on GitHub"
---

Remove a scale set for good: its runners, the safe way round (each runner's registration first, which GitHub refuses for one running a job), and then the scale set on GitHub. A runner running a job is left to finish, and the scale set is kept until it has, unless `--wait` says to wait for it. A scale set still in the configuration is refused: the daemon would make it again.

## Usage

```console
$ rungar scale-sets rm NAME [flags]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--group string` | Runner group the scale set is in on GitHub. Default: `Default`. |
| `--wait` | Wait for runners running jobs to finish, then remove the scale set. |

## Global flags

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--socket string` | The daemon's socket (default `$RUNGAR_SOCKET`, or `/run/rungar/rungar.sock`). |
